title: feat(studio): the All metadata lists mark a base's customizations, with an only-customizations filter and tile counts
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbYJa9oMBxT4YrnmXWABr1eP)_

Fixes #28568

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:Studio「全部元数据」区里，打开一个已安装的基础包(如 HotCRM)时，每个类型列表同时列出基础包和它的定制包 `hotcrm.custom` 的项。被覆盖的项标「已定制（HotCRM）」，定制包新增的项标「新增」;列表多一个「仅看定制（n）」筛选;目录页每个类型卡片显示已定制数(对象卡片另计扩展字段等),页头显示基础包的定制总数。跨包视图(`~all`)里，定制包的项标「HotCRM 的定制」。
- **为什么改**:ADR-0146 D3「一个界面」:管理员要在同一处看出「我们在 HotCRM 上改了什么、加了什么」，包括四大支柱不覆盖的类型(翻译、邮件模板等)。
- **风险与回滚**:低。只读展示，数据全部来自服务器的 `GET /api/v1/packages/:id/customizations`,不做任何比对或推断;读取中或失败时不画标记、不显示数字(失败时显示服务器原话),绝不显示 0;Setup 页面完全不变、也不发这个请求。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/customizationMarks.ts`(哪一行标什么的规则)、`ResourceListPage.tsx` 里列表范围加入定制包那一行、`CustomizationMark.tsx`(全控制台唯一的标记组件，N-19 复用)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadataAreaHost.customizations-28568.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/customizationMarks.test.ts`,预期 2 个文件、16 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **One reader, extended.** `studio-design/packageCustomizations-io.ts` gains `fetchPackageCustomizations(baseId)`. It returns the whole answer of `GET /api/v1/packages/:id/customizations`, judged by `GetPackageCustomizationsResponseSchema`. The landing's `fetchPackageCustomizationCounts` now calls it, so there is still one request path, one schema check and one failure-text rule (`readEnvelopeFailureText`). The pair-id refusal before any request is kept.
- **The rule, pure.** `studio-design/customizationMarks.ts` decides which mark a row carries, from two served facts:
  - the read's `overrides` (type, name and, for a type identified by a pair such as `email_template`'s locale, its `member`);
  - the `_packageId` the list serves the row under. A served override is served under the base's id (ADR-0146 D8 item 2). An item of the pair that overrides nothing is served under the pair's id.
  A row the read lists as an override is `customized`, whether it is served under the base or the pair. Any other row of the pair is `added`. The base's other rows and every other package carry nothing. There is no diff and no `basedOn` verdict (D2, D6). The same module counts by type for the directory: the overrides of the type, plus the extension members on `object`. The header total is served overrides plus served extensions, the landing's "customized" figure.
- **One mark component.** `studio-design/CustomizationMark.tsx` exports `CustomizationMark` (kinds `customized`, `added`, `customizationOf`) and `usePackageCustomizations(baseId)`. The hook has four states: off, loading, failed with the server's sentence, and read. It names the base from the package list the area already reads, shared through `packages-io.ts`, and falls back to the id. N-19's pillar rails can reuse both.
- **List (`ResourceListPage.tsx`).**
  - Under the area with a base open, the scope admits the pair's rows beside the base's (`pkg === activePackage || pkg === pairId`).
  - Each row's first cell draws its mark.
  - "Only customizations (n)" appears once the read has answered and the base has a customization. It narrows the list to the marked rows.
  - A failed read shows its sentence under the filter row.
  - In the cross-package leg, a row served under a `BASE.custom` id is labelled "Customization of BASE" (`customizationBasePackageId`).
- **Directory (`DirectoryPage.tsx`).** Each tile shows the type's served customization count, and only when it is above zero. The header shows the base's total. A failed read shows the sentence and no number.
- **Setup is unchanged.** With no area provider, the host is `null`, so no read is made and no pair row is admitted.
- **Strings.** Thirteen keys go into `@object-ui/i18n`'s studio namespace, in `en` and `zh`: `engine.customizationMark.*`, `engine.directory.customizations.*` and `engine.list.customizations.only`. The placeholders are `base`, `pair`, `customized`, `marked` and `message`. There is no `count` token.

## Tests

`metadataAreaHost.customizations-28568.test.tsx` runs the real list, the real directory and the real reader under an area provider. Only `fetch` and the metadata client are stubbed. The fixture is base HotCRM with one overridden translation, one added email template, one extension field, and an override of a different email-template member. The cases are the card's five plus three controls:

- The translation list marks the override "Customized (HotCRM)". Toggling the filter shows that row alone, and toggling back restores the rest. The base's unlisted row is unmarked.
- The email-template list holds the pair's `renewal_notice` marked "Added". The base's `welcome` in `en` is unmarked, because the read overrides only its `zh-CN` member.
- The directory's object tile reads "1 customized" from the extension. The translation and email-template tiles read 1 each, and the header reads "3 customized on HotCRM". A type with no customization draws no number.
- A failed read (503 with an error envelope) draws no mark, no filter and no number on the list or the directory. It shows the server's sentence.
- A base without a pair (an empty read) is unchanged: no mark, no filter, no failure line.
- Control: Setup (no area) makes no customization read and marks nothing.
- The cross-package leg labels a pair's permission set with its base. It makes no read, and the base's own item names no base.

`customizationMarks.test.ts` pins the pure rule (10 cases): override under the base or the pair, member identity, type identity, other packages, a pair id that has no pair, the per-type counts and the total.

## Acceptance notes

- **Tiles and the header count what the read lists.** That is overrides, plus extensions on `object`. An "added" item of the pair is marked and filterable in its list, but no tile or header counts it, because N-15's read does not list items the pair adds. So a list's "Only customizations (n)" can be larger than its tile's number. Counting added items needs the read to serve them (a change to N-15's declaration), or a second count, which the card rules out ("from N-15's served counts").
- **The directory's item counts and tile list are the base's alone.** The diagnostics sweep behind them (`useGlobalDiagnostics` in `useMetadata.ts`) is scoped to one package. A type that only the pair holds therefore draws no tile on the base's directory, and a tile's item count does not include the pair's rows. That type's list does show them. Closing this needs a second, pair-scoped sweep in `useMetadata.ts`, which is outside the claimed file surface. It is left for the seat to card or carry.
- **A pair row opens in the pair's area.** Its link carries `?package=PAIR` (the row's owning package, ADR-0048), and the area re-roots a `?package=` naming another package onto that package (`areaLocationRedirect`). An added item therefore opens writable, in `/studio/PAIR/metadata/...`. This is the area's existing rule, unchanged here.
- **Type identity.** The list route's `:type` is matched against the read's canonical singular `type`. Both come from the same registry vocabulary, so no alias is folded.
- **Clause-② measured.** Every new string is in the studio namespace (a plain string table, outside the `locales/*` packs), so the claim's `Clause-②: no` holds.
- **NOT MEASURED: a live Console.** No dev server was run. The route was mounted by #28635 and is read live by the landing (#28634). This PR exercises it only through the stubbed answers above.

## Verification

Readings are at head `879da8ff`, unless a step names another head. `f42f397b`, the head after it, changes only the changeset text.

<details><summary>New and neighbouring suites · 39 files · 356 tests</summary>

The set is every ui test file that names `DirectoryPage`, `ResourceListPage`, `packageCustomizations-io`, `CustomizationMark`, `customizationMarks`, `metadataAreaHost` or `StudioMetadataArea` (`git grep -l`), the two new files included. It ran under `os-verify-lock` with `--maxWorkers=2`: Test Files 39 passed (39), Tests 356 passed (356). This is a declared narrowing; CI's Test UI shards run the rest of app-shell.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations · both red</summary>

Both ran through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` against the committed fix. Each restored the file with blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

1. The override key drops `member`: 2 failed (the member-identity unit case and the email-template list case).
2. The list scope drops the pair's rows: 2 failed (the email-template list case and the failed-read case, which still lists the pair's row).
</details>

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: exit 0, at `52eb6b11` and again at `879da8ff`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check`: exit 0.
- `eslint` on the nine touched files: 0 errors (warnings only).
</details>

Every command exited 0.
- At `f42f397b`, 31 of them ran, the PR-body gates against this body among them.

  - `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 169 files and 4900 tests passed, 2 skipped;
  - `check:query-options-erasure`;
  - `check:type-check-debt`, under the lock.

`dispatch-gates --ran`: 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
